learnings: API errors on non-executable files (license texts, metadata) should not force an 'inconclusive' verdict when the critical PKGBUILD has been successfully audited as safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security uncertainty' and 'inconclusive due to tool failures' - the latter should not block a verdict when core files are reviewed
License files and REUSE metadata could be deprioritized or batch-reviewed to reduce API call failures on trivial content
